name: Nothing Shows
tagline: Shows about nothing where everything matters.

questions.funFact: Leslie David Baker (Stanley) is an actual crossword puzzle enthusiast. The producers let him do real puzzles during filming.

questions.questionText: Which actor shares his entire real name with his character on The Office?
questions.funFact: The real Creed Bratton was a member of the 1960s band The Grass Roots. His character's mysterious past mirrors his real eclectic life.

questions.questionText: What is the name of Pam, Oscar, and Toby's exclusive club in The Office?
questions.funFact: The Finer Things Club episodes feature real literary discussions. The cast actually read the books they reference on screen.

questions.questionText: What does Rainn Wilson originally audition for on The Office?
questions.funFact: Rainn Wilson auditioned for Michael Scott, and John Krasinski originally read for Dwight. The casting director swapped them.

questions.questionText: Who starred in the original British version of The Office?
questions.funFact: Ricky Gervais and Stephen Merchant kept creative control. They approved Steve Carell personally after watching his audition tape.

questions.questionText: What does Michael Scott describe wine as in The Office episode 'Dinner Party'?
questions.funFact: The 'oaky afterbirth' line was improvised by Steve Carell. The other actors' disgusted reactions were completely genuine.
